_geometry: Radii fitted with `imagespin fit`; every divider verified to sit in an empty gap with `imagespin check`. Layers are CHAINED (each inner boundary IS the next outer boundary) so nothing can tear. Two same-phase 7-gons only nest when r_inner <= 0.901 * r_outer, which is why not every gap is used.
_turns: Positive turns are COUNTER-CLOCKWISE. Layers 5-7 share a rate deliberately: the heptagons at 153.5 and 121.5 and the rows of names between them read as one piece, and no cut can put them in one layer (below 121.5 needs R <= 119.5; clearing the pentagram points at 108.6 needs R >= 120.5). A shared rate does the same job. Beware a layer sharing a SPEED with one it should not read with, direction notwithstanding.
